title: Friends
tagline: The people who knew before anyone else.

questions.text: When did you first know we were going to be friends?
What is a habit of mine you would miss if we stopped talking?
What do you think I would do in a situation you have never seen me in?
What is something you would tell me that you would not tell anyone else?
What is the thing we were best at doing together?
When did you last feel like talking to me, and did you?
What do you think is my worst habit?
What is something you would like me to do more of?
Who else knows me as well as you do?
What would you say has changed in me, and when?
Describe your perfect day off with me, in detail.
What is something I do that you find genuinely funny?
What is a piece of advice you wish someone had given you at my age?
What is something you would like to do again, like we used to?
What is a moment you felt really proud to be friends with me?
What is your favourite thing about being friends with me?
What would you do if I asked you to help me move at short notice?
What is the worst advice I have ever given you?
What is something you wish I would stop doing?
When did you last feel truly supported by me?
What is something about being friends with me that you did not expect?
What would you say has been the best year of your life so far?
What is something in your life right now that you wish more people knew about?
What would you want me to know about you that I might have missed?
What is a small thing that would make this week better?
Describe a moment you felt left out, and by whom.
What would you want me to know that you have never told me?
What do you think I am avoiding?
What would make today feel like a good day?
What is something you would like us to do before the year is out?
Describe the version of you that I would not recognise today.
What is a subject you could talk about for hours with anyone?
What is the most fun thing you have done in the last year?
What would you want your friendship with me to look like at fifty?
What is something I said to you that stuck with you?
What is a small thing I do that makes your day better?
What is something you are proud of that you have not told me?
When did you last feel really happy, and who was there?
What would you want to be remembered for, as a friend?
What is something you have never told me, and do not want to?
What would make you feel less alone this week?
What is a question you have wanted to ask me for ages?
Describe a time you felt really let down by someone.
What do you think friendship should give people?
What is a friendship you have lost touch with, and why?
What would you do if I told you I was struggling, and had not said anything?
What is the nicest thing someone has done for you recently?
What would you like us to do more of, just for fun?
What is something you would want to say out loud but have not?
What is your favourite thing about who you are with me?
What would you like to do when we all have free time?
What is something that made you laugh so hard you cried?
What is a small thing you want to start this month?
What do you think is the best thing about me that I do not see?
What is a place you would want to visit with me?
What would you want to say to me if I were listening right now?
Describe a time you felt genuinely supported by someone.
What is something you would like me to know about friendship?
What is a goal you have that you have not told anyone about?
What would you like us to have done more of, when we were younger?
What is one thing you would never forgive me for?
What would you want your friendship with me to look like in ten years?
What is something you are looking forward to?
What do you think is the most important thing about a friend?
What is something I would do for you that I would not do for anyone else?
What is the nicest thing you have done for me that I never thanked you for?
What would you like to be asked about, instead of how I am?
What is something you would like to be better at?
What would you do if you had to describe our friendship in one word?
What is a small thing you would like me to ask you about more?
What is the last thing that made you feel like yourself?
What would you want me to do if I was having a bad week and did not say anything?
What is something you would like to do this year that is just for fun?
What is a place we should go this year?
What would you like to do together that we have never done?
What do you think we should do more of, just because it is fun?
What is something you would want me to keep doing forever?
What is one thing that would make this year feel like a good one?
What would you say is the most generous thing I have ever done?
What is something about you that I would like to understand better?
